text:
emma: Quick heads-up — the /v1/embeddings/batch example in the API reference shows `input` as a single object field. That’s causing confusion and the JS SDK snippet fails (it expects `inputs: string[]`).

emma: Current curl on the page:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"embed-mlp", "input":"hello"}'
```

emma: It should be:```json
{
  "model": "embed-mlp",
  "inputs": ["hello","world"]
}
```

jorge: Good catch — does this also break the Go snippet? I saw a clientgen test failure this morning.

emma: Yes. clientgen used the example to infer the request shape; Go example currently shows `Input string` → compile error. I opened a failing test: github.com/redwood-inference/clientgen#456 (failing because example json unmarshals to wrong type).

anika: I can update the docs example and add a short migration note calling out the array vs object issue. Where do you want the migration note? `docs/migration/embeddings-requests.md`?

ryan: Put it in docs/migration and add a small "Examples that changed" subsection. Also add a one-line changelog entry in the docs release notes. Can we add a smoke check that parses examples as JSON to avoid regressions?

jorge: I'll open a PR that updates the page and replaces the JS/Go snippets. Assigning @anika for the migration note and @ryan for the docs smoke test. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 (WIP).

anika: SG. I'll add a before/after snippet with recommended quickfix for customers who hard-coded `input` in integrations. Example to include:
```diff
- { "model": "embed-mlp", "input": "hello" }
+ { "model": "embed-mlp", "inputs": ["hello"] }
```

ryan: When PR is up, please run a local site build (`make site-build`) and paste the preview link here. Also leave CI and lint comments in the PR so docs-bot posts the preview.

docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-812--docs.redwood.ai/embed-samples (auto).

emma: :thumbsup: After merge we should bump clientgen tests and cut a patch release for SDKs (JS + Go). @jorge can you coordinate release notes?

jorge: Yep — I'll include a short note under "SDK: embedding request shape examples fixed" and call out how to migrate. Will also tag internal SDK owners for a micro release.

emma: Thanks all — small change but high customer impact. I'll add a quick integration test snippet to the example page showing batching with 2 inputs.

anika: Cool. I'll update the migration doc and link it from the API page in the PR.

ryan: Once merged, let's run the snapshot generator to ensure the generated snippets match the rendered examples.

emma: Filed follow-ups in the PR checklist. Leaving this thread open until PR merged.
